description: React component for managing a list of useful links, including fetch, add, edit, delete, reorder, and save functionality, with role-based access control.

classes.name: UsefulLinksManagement
classes.description: React functional component for managing useful links with CRUD and reorder capabilities, accessible only to admin users.

methods.name: fetchUsefulLinks
methods.description: Fetches useful links data from backend and updates component state.

methods.name: saveLinksToBackend
methods.description: Saves the current links array to backend in the specified object format.

methods.name: handleAddLink
methods.description: Validates and adds a new link to the list, then persists changes.

methods.name: handleEditLink
methods.description: Sets the link to be edited.

methods.name: handleUpdateLink
methods.description: Validates and updates the existing link, then saves changes.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing mode for a link.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Removes a link from the list and updates backend.

methods.name: setCurrentLink
methods.description: Opens the specified URL in a new tab.

methods.name: handleCancelRearranging
methods.description: Cancels the rearrangement process and restores original order.

methods.name: handleMoveUp
methods.description: Moves a link up in the list.

methods.name: handleMoveDown
methods.description: Moves a link down in the list.
